Role Description:
The Marketing Automation Manager will execute our integrated marketing automation programs that drive pipeline creation and support YoY growth goals. This role will own the technical build-out of workflows, campaigns, and lead routing that ladder to our demand gen growth mandate. The ideal candidate is self-sufficient, detail-oriented, data-driven, and analytical, with a strong technical understanding of marketing automation platforms, CRM systems, and funnel metrics.
In this role, you will be responsible for executing automation programs that support integrated demand generation initiatives: from inbound and ABM segments to events and webinars. You'll ensure leads flow through the right journeys, get actioned at the right time, and are tracked accurately so we can measure what's working and optimize for pipeline impact.
You'll work within frameworks and strategy set by cross-functional leaders and be responsible for building, QA'ing, and maintaining the automation that runs them at scale. You'll partner closely with Campaign Management, RevOps, and Sales to keep our tech stack (HubSpot, Salesforce, 6sense, Goldcast, ads platforms) working together, and to use funnel data to identify where automation or routing changes could drive better conversion rates and pipeline sourced/influenced results.
Big picture: you'll be the execution backbone that turns demand generation strategy into repeatable, measurable automation. This role reports to the Director, Digital Marketing.
What you’ll do:
Build and execute marketing automation programs that drive pipeline growth
Build complex, multi-touch nurture programs segmented by prospect type, journey stage, account attributes, and engagement. Include segment-specific programs, ABM account-based workflows, and clearly defined enrollment, suppression, re-enrollment, exit, and sales-handoff logic designed cross-functionally.
Build, QA, and maintain expert-level HubSpot forms with progressive profiling, dependent and hidden fields, conditional logic, dynamic requirements, and consent management; troubleshoot submission, deduplication, and Salesforce sync issues.
Build responsive HubSpot landing pages using Design Manager, reusable modules, smart content, personalization, and A/B testing to support demand generation campaigns.
Build and maintain complex, multi-branch HubSpot workflows for lead scoring, lifecycle management, routing, and campaign membership; architect, test, and troubleshoot to prevent automation conflicts, loops, duplicate actions, and unintended field overwrites.
Operationalize Salesforce Campaign tracking through HubSpot: manage campaign hierarchies, Campaign Member creation, standardized member statuses, "Responded" logic, UTM capture, and automated campaign association for accurate attribution and reporting.
Build and send transactional customer-facing emails regarding fulfillment and product updates.
